# SilphNet

> A free, open-source multiplayer presence mod for Pokemon Gen 1 Recomp (a Pokemon Red/Blue/Yellow decompilation/recompilation engine). Log in with a name and password, get a unique Trainer ID, add friends in-game by Trainer ID, and see their last-known map positions - no live movement, no persistent server process, just an ordinary PHP + MySQL backend behind a plain-HTTP client.

SilphNet is not an official Pokemon or Nintendo product. It is a community-made mod for the fan-made, open-source Gen1Recomp engine (https://github.com/bryanthaboi/gen1recomp), created and maintained by Ash Brittain (AshJam).

## What it does

- Presence, not real-time multiplayer: friends appear as static map markers showing where they were last seen (refreshed on a timer while playing), not live-moving avatars.
- Add friends in-game using a 5-digit Trainer ID, entered with a D-pad digit spinner - no typing, no external app needed.
- A friends list shows each friend's online/offline status, current map, and time since last seen.
- A friend detail screen shows self-reported stats (badges, Pokedex progress, League wins, money, time played), current party, and latest catch activity.
- A "who's nearby" screen shows everyone else (friend or not) currently on your own map.
- An "SN ONLINE" screen shows a live count of everyone online, grouped by game version (Red/Blue/Yellow), with the same add-friend flow.
- Account management (username, Trainer ID, password, optional recovery email) is available on the website, separate from the in-game mod.
- Works identically on desktop and mobile, wherever Gen1Recomp itself runs.

## Key facts

- Free to use. Source code is on GitHub: https://github.com/AshJamB/SilphNet
- Built on plain HTTP requests to a small PHP + MySQL API - no dedicated game server, no VPS required to self-host.
- Passwords are hashed (bcrypt), never stored or recoverable in plaintext.
- No battles, trades, or chat between players - presence and friends only, by design.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://silphnet.jamshark.co.uk/): overview, install instructions, live players-online count.
- [My account](https://silphnet.jamshark.co.uk/account.php): manage your username, Trainer ID, password, and recovery email (requires login).
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/AshJamB/SilphNet): source code, releases, install instructions.

## Install

1. Install the mod (`dist/silphnet.zip` from GitHub, or directly via the in-game Mod Manager's Update screen).
2. Enable SilphNet in the Mod Manager and allow the "network" permission.
3. Set MY NAME and PASSWORD in the mod's options - the first login with a new name creates an account and assigns a Trainer ID automatically.
4. Add friends in-game using their Trainer ID.
